title: Thin-cone condition around a plane, propagated from small to large radii via conical approximation
statement: Assume ConicalApproximationTheorem. For n >= 1, p > n, gamma in (0,1), kappa in (0, (1-gamma)/8] and c_0 in (0, 1/4] there is delta_C > 0 such that for every open U, contract varifold V with generalized mean curvature H, 0 < delta <= delta_C and rho with AllardHypotheses H p delta rho, and every linear subspace T: if dist(x, T) <= (kappa/2)|x| for all x in spt V cap B_{c_0 rho}(0), then dist(y, T) <= kappa |y| for all y in spt V cap B_{(1+gamma) rho/2}(0).
lean_statement: ConicalApproximationTheorem → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ γ κ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < γ → γ < 1 → 0 < κ → κ ≤ (1 - γ) / 8 → 0 < c₀ → c₀ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∃ δC : ℝ, 0 < δC ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δC → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall 0 (c₀ * ρ), infDist x (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ κ / 2 * ‖x‖) → ∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall 0 ((1 + γ) / 2 * ρ), infDist y (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ κ * ‖y‖
